text: 创业板指涨超3%，新易盛涨超15%，中际旭创涨超13%，算力硬件、短剧、游戏、机器人等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股超3800只。
text_en: ChiNext Index up more than 3%, Eoptolink up more than 15%, Zhongji Innolight up more than 13%, with computing power hardware, short dramas, gaming and robotics among the top gainers, and more than 3,800 stocks up across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets.
